svg.title: Stream-WAM streaming overview, temporal overlap, and action-conditioned attention
svg.desc: The global spacetime overview shows consecutive Stream updates overlapping continuous robot execution. The lower temporal view aligns the shared action prefix with known action context and look-ahead with unknown future slots. A ten-by-ten attention mask highlights the two action-prefix links into the next visual-future query.

g.text: previous actions condition only the next visual future
